title: The BRCK: A Router Sketched on a Flight Home for Nairobi's Blackouts
conflicts: First production run: MIT Technology Review (May 2013) said 1,000 units, TechCentral (May 2013) said 2,000 units in Shenzhen; Business Daily (Aug 2014) reported the first 800 shipped. The story gives only the dated shipped figure. Idea date: Hersman's May 2013 post says the flight was 'a year ago'; Business Daily (2014) says November 2011; both attributed. Kickstarter: Business Daily $172,107 from 1,078 backers, Vice 'about $172,000'; story uses Business Daily. Price $199 (Business Daily) vs about $200 (TechCentral); story uses $199.
notes: Repeat screen flagged the Ushahidi seed edition as same-founder and let it through; this is a different episode (2011-13 hardware design, not the 2008 crisis map). Founders listed as Hersman, Rotich, Orton and Walton: CrazyEngineers names Hersman, Orton and Walton as co-founders and Vice calls Rotich a co-founder. Funding set to 'mixed' rather than the slate's 'venture': at the time Ushahidi (nonprofit) self-funded the R&D and Kickstarter funded production; venture money came later. Hersman's blog domain is now parked, so his 6 May 2013 post is cited from the Internet Archive (Jan 2014 capture) plus a Ventureburn repost. Stance 'affirms'.
